metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to get rid of shoulder blade muscle tightness and pain for good!

We'll keep it easy in this video with a straightforward guide that is going to not only focus on getting quick shoulder blade (scapula) pain relief, but also to help get rid of it for good in the future.

All of these exercises are easy to do, can be done at home, and require no special equipment.

Watch now and quickly fix shoulder blade pain at home! 

Chapters:
0:00 Intro

PART ONE: Muscle Pain and Tightness Relief
0:31 Muscle Knot and Spasm Fix

PART TWO: Mobility Stretching
3:43 Figure 8
6:16 Scapular Wall Slide

PART THREE: Strengthening Exercises 
8:05 Shoulder Blade Pump
10:11 Forearm Door Slider
11:33 Shoulder Blade Lift-Off
